description: A Jupyter Notebook containing Python code for integrating OpenAI and GEMINI models to generate SQL queries and answers based on a database schema related to a school management system. It includes code for environment setup, database connection, model initialization, prompt generation, query extraction, data retrieval, and answer generation.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt string combining user question and additional instructions for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a prompt to OpenAI's chat completion API and returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql and ``` from the model's output.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from GEMINI model response parts.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates the cost based on token usage for query and answer outputs.
